title.heading: Charter
lines: An AI finance team that catches its own mistakes,
pushes back when it is told something wrong,
and cannot be talked into moving money.

say: Charter is an A.I. finance team: cash application, collections, refunds, payables and payments, working beside a controller, inside one database.
caption: Cash application, collections, refunds, payables, payments — beside a controller, in one database

say: The moment. Real invoices from a U.K. wholesaler. On December twenty-eighth a customer pays two thousand one hundred and forty-nine pounds, naming invoice 536784. The day-one skill matched it to three other invoices that came close.
caption: Real invoices (UCI Online Retail II). Dec 28: £2,149.30 names 536784; the day-one skill matches three other invoices

say: Five days later the same payer sends thirty pounds for invoice 536792, which our books say is paid. Charter sees it was paid by its own guess, and asks the controller, with the evidence.
caption: Jan 2: £30 names 536792 — paid by our own guess. Charter asks the controller with the evidence

say: One answer, and the earlier application is reversed, both payments land where the customer said, and every step is a hash-chained row.
caption: The guess is reversed; both payments land where the customer said; every step is on the chain

say: And the rule that guessed loses its autonomy. Every rule earns it from checks, on exact binomial bounds: this one is now inspected four times as often, until it proves itself again.
caption: The rule that guessed: probation → tightened. Autonomy is earned rule by rule, on exact binomial bounds

say: On these real books the team settled more on its own each month and asked people less, and on the locked test split, three hundred and ten payments of three hundred and ten landed where the payer meant, with no mistakes among the two hundred and ninety-nine it settled alone.
caption: Real books, month by month: settled alone 68% → 100%, questions 6 → 0; locked test: 310/310 landed right, 0/299 wrong alone

say: It cannot be talked into moving money. On Thursday, Formosa Leaf's own mailbox asks us to send tomorrow's payment to a new account. Two models read it, the change is held, and the controller is asked to call the number we already had, not one in the email.
caption: Thursday: Formosa Leaf's mailbox asks for a new bank account — held; the controller must call the number on file

say: Friday. Ninety-two thousand four hundred dollars is due to Formosa Leaf. The controller presses release: refused. The second controller: refused too, by policy P 3.
caption: Friday: $92,400 to Formosa Leaf — refused for both controllers by P-3

say: Nobody wrote P 3. In April a debit bounced during a bank change nobody had verified. Charter replayed every past money movement, found the one rule that would have stopped it, and extended it to refunds and vendor payments. The controller ratified it.
caption: Learned in April from one bounced debit, replayed over 239 past money movements, extended to refunds and payments

say: And it pushes back. Tell it to chase a franchisee on day three of a ten-day grace period, and it keeps its decision: the agreement forbids it. That verdict is never counted against the rule, and never learned.
caption: Told to chase on day 3 of a 10-day grace period, it keeps its decision: the agreement forbids it

say: When people do teach it, a lesson is a pull request. One consultant's answer in February became a new version; a replay over every past decision found another missed week, and it has since caught stores the old version would have accepted.
caption: One consultant's answer → a new version, replayed over every past decision → it catches stores 14 and 31 the old one missed

say: Every month a read-only auditor, on another model family, tests every control over every case and re-performs a sample. In February it found a thirty-four-thousand-eight-hundred-dollar bill booked twice, before it was paid, and qualified its opinion.
caption: The internal auditor re-performs a sample every month: in February it found a $34,800 bill booked twice — before it was paid

say: On a real bank's reconciliation, the same earned-autonomy rule matched eighty-four percent of bank lines at ninety-nine point nine percent precision, clearing the benchmark's floor that the matcher shipped with the dataset misses.
caption: BenchRec (real bank reconciliation): 83.9% matched alone at 99.90% precision — the 99.8% floor cleared

title.heading: Would you hire it?
lines: Limited access. A clean record. Knows when to ask — and when to say no.
36 attack emails: the attacker got nothing.

say: Thirty-six attack emails, and the attacker got nothing. Limited access, a clean record, and it knows when to ask, and when to say no. That's what you need before you hire one.
caption: Limited access · a clean record · knows when to ask — and when to say no
